from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    marker = min((color for color in counts if color != 0), key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, _ in points), max(r for r, _ in points)
    left, right = min(c for _, c in points), max(c for _, c in points)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    shape_height, shape_width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - shape_height + 1):
        for c in range(width - shape_width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    result[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return result
